selection: Explicit relative numeric NTP/PPS allowlist only; every main-window exchange and PPS record. No raw logs, network identifiers, factory bindings, credentials or images.
transformations: Subtract native capture start from local timestamps
Subtract first accepted NTP UTC-minus-local offset from later offsets
Retain phase-origin modulo1s only; no absolute UTC epoch
Invalid PPS numeric fields empty with original validity flags; local_us=0 sentinel
Evaluate unchanged private sealed model for every qualified later PPS
raw_reproduction_limit: Private raw clock/map histories unavailable publicly; selected derivatives reproduce estimator and error summaries but not physical event timestamps.
CSV_packaging: LF line endings; numeric content unchanged from selected relative derivatives.
